description: Prepare an exact Safe withdrawal transaction after allowlist checks. USDC.e means bridged USDC.e on Polygon, which many centralized exchanges do not support; prefer a self-custody Polygon wallet and convert before an exchange deposit. Returns EIP-712 data for the owner to sign locally; no money moves yet.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Auto-generated when omitted.

withdrawal_confirmation.description: Email-confirmation proof for this exact withdrawal, returned by /v1/withdraw/confirmation/verify. Required by the engine for a new withdrawal preparation.

proof.description: Opaque verified proof; never a private key or email code.

name: prepare_withdrawal
